line.en: A small tabletop world of rounded, hand-pressed clay under soft studio light, in real 3D.

for.en: Nature and life science, children's science, growth and cycles, in a small real-3D clay world.
for.zh-CN: 自然与生命科学、儿童科普、生长与循环过程，在一个真 3D 的黏土小世界里。

not.en: Abstract data, finance and software; weak devices, since it renders in real 3D.
not.zh-CN: 抽象数据、金融和软件；它是真 3D 渲染，弱设备吃力。
